data.standardized_narrative: Insufficient extractable data in the provided scanned images to determine a reliable gross prior-year reserve movement. The opening gross claims outstanding (gross claims reserves at 1 January 2016) was read from the Balance Sheet prior-year column as approximately GBP 341.743m. No unambiguous gross prior-year movement figure (strengthening or release) could be identified from the movement notes, claims development table or narrative in the scanned pages available.
data.data_quality_notes: Source documents were provided as low-resolution scanned images. The Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding prior year column) was legible enough to extract the opening gross claims outstanding (31 Dec 2015 balance used as 1 Jan 2016 opening) as ~GBP 341.743m (page 11). However, the notes required to determine a GROSS prior-year reserve movement (e.g. 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' with an Insurance Liabilities/gross column, or a clear claims development triangle) were not reliably readable in the supplied images. Several numeric tables and P&L technical account rows were visible but ambiguous; per the extraction rules I have not used P&L 'Claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines. Because no clear gross prior-year movement could be located, prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. If higher-resolution images or the original PDF text are supplied, I can extract the gross prior-year development, detailed LOB movements and the claims development triangle.
